description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures, adding {R} for each one.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Repeat from 3.
